data.narrative:
Focused Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Thomas Forner and Markus Roth. The valuation universe includes 3 public comps (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, though the narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier remains limited.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the primary triangulation basis. Using total capital raised of $240M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $480M. This reflects the expected markup from early-stage capital deployment to next-round pricing. The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while 4 same-sector nuclear peers exist, fewer than 3 comps match both stage and valuation tier simultaneously, making a narrow median unreliable and an all-sector median inappropriately broad.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $408M (low) to $552M (high), with a median of $480M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties center on the scarcity of true peer comparables at identical stage and valuation in nuclear energy, limiting cross-validation. Capital intensity, regulatory trajectory, and technology maturity relative to peers remain critical value drivers not fully captured by stage-based mechanics alone. A tighter range would require either expanded private comp data or public market comp refinement.
